otherWay.text: Owner cash in the latest 12 months was 14.3% of revenue, above the 3.0% line.
The company paid $2.3 billion to buy back shares and $166 million in dividends over the period.
Operating costs fell from 58.7% of revenue in 2021 to 51.0% in 2025.

summary: From fiscal 2007 to 2025, BOSTON SCIENTIFIC CORPORATION reported $194.2 billion of revenue and $20.8 billion of free cash flow. Stock pay was $3.0 billion, which leaves $17.8 billion of owner cash: 9.2% of revenue.
Owner cash was under 3.0% of revenue in 2 of 19 years.
In the 12 months to 2026-09-30 it was 14.3% of revenue.
